name: Self Acceptance
overview: Scripture reveals that true self-acceptance begins with recognizing that we are fearfully and wonderfully made by God (Psalms 139:14) and that His love is demonstrated through the sacrifice of Christ, who died for us while we were still sinners (Romans 5:8). This acceptance is not based on our own efforts but is a gift of grace received through faith (Ephesians 2:8). Jesus invites all who are burdened to come to Him for rest (Matthew 11:28), assuring believers of their value and identity grounded in God's redeeming love (John 3:16).
